text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for having me at A
Festival☆of a
Hundred Idols! My name's
Falco, and I'll be
representing Umadols!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Wow, you really did come to see
me! Thanks
a lot!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? ☆ Look at you! You're
practically
my biggest fan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show everyone how great
Umadols
are now, so don't you take your
eyes off me,
'kay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch from behind the crowd,
waiting for
Smart Falcon to appear on
stage...

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Looks like an "Umadol" is up next. Wait,
what
even is an Umadol? That's not a
regular idol,
right? You know anything
about this?

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Nope. First time hearing it... I guess we'll
just have
to wait and see.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. She'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have faith in her unique charm—an
Umadol's
charm.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hiii! I sing and dance and run at full
speed! It's
your favorite Umadol, Smart
Falcon! ☆

text_block_list.name: Idol Fans
text_block_list.text: Uma...dol?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see lots of confused faces, so lemme
explain!
You see, Umadols are a new
type of idol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umadols compete in races and sing at
winning
concerts! Their sparkling
splendor brings hope to
all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pour all my feelings into this
next song,
so please listen carefully!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The backing track starts up... and there's
an
immediate shift in the air.

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wh-what's going on? It feels like
she's
transmitting something directly to
my brain...

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Are we at... a racecourse? This has to be
a
winning concert!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone, can you hear me? Is my
message
getting through? I love
Umadols! I really do!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(They run for the sake of standing on
stage, and
do their best to shine as
brightly as they can
there! And that's
why I love them so much!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(I want everyone here to love Umadols
too! Take
in these feelings of mine and
keep them in your
heart!)

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I can hear her feelings loud and
clear. I
can tell how hard she's trying to
shine!

text_block_list.name: Idol Fan B
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! You'd have to be a heartless
monster not
to wave your lightsticks for
her! WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Smart Falcon is able to get
her
feelings across to everyone
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for listening to
my song!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Were you able to learn a thing or two
about
Umadols? I hope this is the start
of something
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umadols shine their brightest at the
winning
concerts! Please come to a race
to see for
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and make it a dirt race if you can! I
run at my
cutest and most powerful in
dirt races! ☆

text_block_list.name: Idol Fans
text_block_list.text: Whoa... You're saying the show gets better than this?! Now I have to see a race live and in person!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
She captures the hearts of all who see
her. Sie ist
das Umadol.
